name: Spire Plus
author: wenhuorongbing-netizen
description: Spire Plus is a single Slay the Spire 2 gameplay expansion for private testing. Enable this one mod to test inspectable Ancient relic rewards, selected vanilla relic revisions, preview tools, and A11-A20 test rules: Blight Sprouts, Rootblight, Firemarked Elites, Banner Rooms, boss dedicated abilities, Branded Form, Crystal Sphere peek, and transform preview. Seedbed plants pollution out of the current combat. Planting is combat-only isolation: no play, discard, or Exhaust triggers; permanent Curses are not deleted; Blight Sprouts are handled; Rootblight is frozen for this combat and remains the same level. Requires BaseLib. 中文：Spire Plus 是用于私测的《杀戮尖塔 2》单体玩法扩展。启用这一个 Mod，可以测试先古之民遗物奖励、原版遗物调整、预览工具和 A11-A20 测试进阶。苗床会把污染牌种下。种下=本战隔离：不算打出、弃牌或消耗；永久诅咒不会被删除；根芽按本战已处理结算；根蚀只冻结这一场，战后保持同等级。
